files.title: Define the order in which siblings are listed
files.body: Decide whether `flattenTree` lists the children of a node in the order they are given or sorted by id. This issue exists to be depended on and is never processed.

issue.title: flattenTree: stop at a maximum depth
issue.body:
## Proposal

Add an optional `maxDepth` argument to `flattenTree`. With `maxDepth: 1` it lists the root and its direct children only. Without it, nothing changes.

The order of siblings has to be decided first.

Depends on: {{lib}}#{{dep.number}}
